maddeler.e:
أتعامل (form VI)
# أَتَعَامَلُ (ʔataʕāmalu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ma.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# أَتَعَامَلَ (ʔataʕāmala) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ma.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# أَتَعَامَلْ (ʔataʕāmal) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.mal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
